in_game_binds.note: Keep these binds in Apex. Do NOT bind crouch to C in-game — C becomes a dedicated DKS key that synthesizes Space then Left Ctrl.

rapid_trigger.note: Leave Rapid Trigger OFF on C so DKS release points stay predictable.

actuation.c_key_note: C uses DKS actuation points below, not the global value.

release_upstroke.description: Official Wooting Apex approach. Hold C while mantling, release at the end of the mantle. Jump fires first on the way up, crouch one travel segment later.
release_upstroke.how_to_use_in_game: Sprint into mantle → hold C through the climb → release C in the last ~0.15s of the mantle.

bindings.order: fires first as you release past 2.7mm
fires second as you continue releasing past 2.5mm

tuning.if_crouch_too_early_same_frame: Widen gap: move crouch shallower (e.g. 2.7 → 2.4) or slow your release slightly.
tuning.if_crouch_too_late_2plus_frames: Narrow gap: move crouch closer to jump (e.g. 2.5 → 2.55–2.6) or release a bit faster.

press_downstroke.description: Alternate smash method. Tap/smash C at the end of the mantle. Jump actuates first, crouch a hair deeper.
press_downstroke.how_to_use_in_game: Sprint into mantle → smash C once in the last ~0.15s of the mantle.

tuning.if_crouch_too_early_same_frame: Increase crouch mm (wider gap) or press a bit slower.
tuning.if_crouch_too_late_2plus_frames: Decrease crouch mm toward jump (narrower gap) or press harder/faster.

trainer_verification.chance_formula: frames = delay_s * fps; if frames < 1: chance = frames*100; elif frames < 2: chance = (2-frames)*100; else 0
